game.badLink: That link has no setlist in it.

attendance.title: My Lives
attendance.description: Log the shows you went to from any live page. Your log stays in this browser — export it or share a link to keep it.
attendance.sharedBanner_one: You're viewing a shared log ({{count}} show).
attendance.sharedBanner_other: You're viewing a shared log ({{count}} shows).
attendance.empty: You haven't logged any shows yet.
attendance.emptyHint: Open a live, find "Were you there?" and mark each show you saw in person, at a live viewing or on stream.
attendance.unrecordedNote_one: {{count}} of these shows has no recorded setlist, so its songs aren't counted.
attendance.unrecordedNote_other: {{count}} of these shows have no recorded setlist, so their songs aren't counted.
attendance.clearConfirm: Remove every show from your log? Export first if you want a backup.
attendance.importFailed: That file isn't a Sekai Setlists export
attendance.importHint: Importing merges the file into your log; shows in both take the file's value.

builder.title: Setlist Builder
builder.welcomeHint: Load a saved prediction or create a new one to get started.
builder.confirmClear: Remove every row from this setlist?
builder.quickAddHint: Drag into the setlist, or double-click to add to the bottom
builder.emptySetlistHint: Search for songs on the left to add them here
builder.dropHere: Drop here to add to setlist
builder.help: Drag songs from the left panel to build your prediction, and drag rows to reorder them. Songs after the ENCORE divider are the encore. Changes are saved automatically in this browser.
builder.loadPredictionDescription: Pick a saved prediction to open in the builder.
builder.editSongDescription: Change the song, its version or add remarks.
builder.remarksHint: Remarks replace the vocalist icons in the setlist.
builder.linkTooLong: This prediction is too long for a link ({{length}} characters). Use JSON export instead.
builder.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
builder.importDescription: Start from a past live, pasted text or a JSON export. This replaces the current setlist.

stats.title: Live Statistics & Infographics
stats.description: Interactive analytics on Project Sekai lives: comparing 2D screen vs 3D cast formats, song release delays, character focus songs, and songs awaiting their stage debut.

format.title: 2D Screen vs 3D Cast Performances
format.subtitle: Comparing virtual character screen projections (COLORFUL LIVE) against real-life voice cast stage performances (Thanks Festival & Fan Meetings).

overlap.title: Song Catalog Overlap Matrix
overlap.subtitle: How the {{total}} performed songs divide between 2D and 3D formats.
overlap.bothDesc: Performed by both the 3DCG virtual characters and the real voice cast
overlap.screen2dDesc: Performed at COLORFUL LIVE, but not yet by the real voice cast on stage
overlap.cast3dDesc: Performed by voice actors at Thanks Fes or Fan Meetings, never at COLORFUL LIVE
overlap.otherDesc: Performed exclusively in Connect Live or Sekai Symphony orchestra

delay.title: Time Between Song Release & Stage Debut
delay.subtitle: Days elapsed from in-game debut (publishedAt) to first live performance (startDate). Negative numbers denote songs that premiered live before releasing in the game!
delay.clickBucket: Click a bar to view songs in bucket
delay.expressTitle: ⚡ Express Lane: Fastest to the Stage
delay.expressSub: Includes pre-release debuts at Anniversary Thanks Festivals & Symphony
delay.longestTitle: ⏳ Veteran Arrivals: Longest Wait to Stage
delay.longestSub: Songs that waited years from launch before their first live performance

focus.title: Character Focus Songs Live Debut Matrix
focus.subtitle: Tracking event-commissioned focus songs for the 20 main characters across Focus Cycles 1–7 and World Link. Click any cell to view song credits and setlists.

version.subtitle: Project SEKAI live concerts overwhelmingly feature full-length versions with complete second verses and extended guitar solos, while short and game-size cuts are reserved for select medley slots.

version.shortNote: Appeared in Sekai Symphony 2026 medleys and select 5th Thanks Fes slots.
